title: Chapter 751
text:
Boom!

The moment the notification popped up on the interface that he had reached level 240, a surge of energy erupted from Han Xiao's body. The lightning-like Mechanical Force was like a tsunami of thunder, leaving scorch marks on the ground and walls.

Level 240 Promotion Mission completed! Promotion successful! END bonus increased! 1 END = 210 Health = 220 Stamina.

The END bonus increased by 35 points, which was five points higher than the last time. In the later stages, the increase with each Promotion would be greater and greater.

[Gene Optimization — Evolution Cube] effect has been triggered.

You have received an additional Race Evolution opportunity.

You have taken another step forward on the path of evolution. Your life level has been enhanced, and your genetic code has been reorganized. This Race Evolution is affected by the Evolution Cube, increasing the chances of mutation options appearing.

Please choose one of the ten options below as your evolved race. Warning! The evolution process is irreversible. Please choose carefully. [Appendix: Evolution Path Characteristics Description]

[Void Commander (Human Form)]: 66-% Compatibility

[Void Devourer (Aberration)]: 42% Compatibility

[Void Ripper (Aberration)]: 38% Compatibility

[Thunder Elemental Tyrant (Energy Form)]: 17% Compatibility

[New Generation Mechanical Race (Human Form)]: 58% Compatibility

[Void Silencer (Human Form)]: 49% Compatibility

[Chaos Demon]: 27% Compatibility

[Void Pathfinder (Human Form)]: 72% Compatibility

[Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy (Energy Body)]: -35% Compatibility

[Child of the Core (Material)] -9.7% Compatibility

Han Xiaoxin stirred.

The influence of the Evolution Cube was very obvious. Among the ten options, there were many mutated evolutionary directions. Sisko was probably like this.

[Void Silencer] and [Primal Chaos Mysterious Ones] were suitable for the Spellcaster system, so there was no need to mention the two Aberrations. His best choice was [Void Navigator], which was the next evolution path of his race. [Void Commander], on the other hand, was a path back to Void Lord.

The Mechanical Race was the bloodline left behind by a Beyond Grade A Mechanic among the 'Primordial Ones'. Becoming a Beyond Grade A Mechanic was equivalent to evolving into a unique new species. They could also reproduce. Beyond Grade As had a long lifespan, which was enough to pass down their race. Today, that Mechanic Primordial One had already died of old age, but the Mechanical Race was still active in the universe. As the name suggested, they were born Mechanics.

Manison of the Mecha Empire was the ruler of the Mechanical Race. He was the second Beyond Grade A of this race.

[Child of the Core] was also a Universal Species with outstanding talent. It was born in the core of a planet and had extremely high resistance.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao chose [Void Pathfinder]. Although the Mechanical Race was suitable for the Mechanic class, its prospects were not as broad as the Void Race. Since he had already evolved to this stage, unless he met an extremely overpowered race, he would not easily change his evolution path.

Selection complete. Race Evolution … Evolution complete!

Race changed to [Void Pathfinder (Human Form)]. Molecular structure improved, organ structure strengthened, metabolism changed, adaptability increased, genetic coding optimized … Your potential has increased!

You have received bonus attributes: + 130 STR, + 180 DEX, + 271 END, + 317 INT, + 169 MYS, + 73 CHA, + 3,180 Energy. Energy Level bonus attributes have changed!

The original five talents did not disappear, but [Void Molt] was strengthened into [Void Blessing], which increased his status by about twenty-five percent.

At the same time, there was a new talent — [Void Passage]!

As the name suggested, it was an advanced version of Void Distortion, directly opening the door to the Void Dimension to the outside world. This was where the name [Void Pathfinder] came from.

Opening the Void Dimension to the outside world had many uses. It could throw the enemy's attacks into the Void Dimension like trash, banish the enemy into the Void, or even connect to certain areas in the Void Dimension and release the creatures in the Void.

The only downside was that the cooldown time was a little long. Otherwise, he would have been able to hide the Mech Legion inside. In terms of carrying the Mech Legion, the unactivated [Secondary Dimension Army] was still more useful.

You have met the prerequisites: Personal Energy Rank must exceed 32759.1 Ona during the Promotion, breaking through the critical point of life level.

[Species Transformation] activated!

At this moment, the originally lukewarm pain level suddenly increased by several levels. Han Xiao's face suddenly twisted. He felt as if someone was constantly pumping air into his body, causing it to swell more and more, as if his body would explode at any moment.

"Species Transformation … This is it!" Han Xiao gritted his teeth and stared at the interface.

This was the true sublimation of a Beyond Grade A!

Your life level has reached a critical point. You have found your own direction on the path of evolution. An unprecedented transformation will befall you. From today onward, you will be a unique existence in the universe …

Detecting evolution route … Detection complete.

You have evolved through [Carbon Human (Yellow)], [Type I Space Human], [Void Prowler (Human Form)], [Chaos Observer (Human Form)], [Void Distorter (Human Form)], [Void Star Pursuer (Human Form)], [Void Pathfinder (Human Form)] …

[Please select 10 from these Racial Talents …]

Many options appeared on the interface, all of which were the Racial Talents that he had once possessed. Some of them had disappeared due to the Species Evolution and were now available.

This is a unique Racial Transformation, integrating all the essence of the previous evolutions … Han Xiao understood.

Because he walked the Void System, he could give up some of the repetitive talents, so it was very easy to choose. First, he kept all six of the strongest talents of [Void Pathfinder]. Han Xiao then chose two talents of [Chaos Observer] — [Void Vision — Observer] and [Observer's Mark]. He had missed these two abilities for a long time, and now, he finally had the chance to take them back!

Of the remaining two, he chose [Chaos Entity Release] and [Adaptability]. The latter was the jack-of-all-trades talent of the Space Human Race, giving him a + 10% Physical, Abnormal, and Psychic Resistance. Considering the threat of Sisko, he chose this ability.

After confirming his choice, a new notification popped up on the interface.

Please select two of the five Species Evolution Options below to receive a talent each.

1. [Chaos Apostle (Human Form)]

2. [Void Destroyer (Aberration)]

3. [Void Missionary (Psychic Body)]

4. [High Grade Ethereal God Race]

5. [Holy — Cosmic Beast Race]

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

The previous ten talents were chosen from the previous evolutions, and the two he chose now were chosen from the next stage of Species Evolution.

Because the Beyond Grade As would give birth to their Exclusive Race, their Species Evolution would strengthen their Exclusive Race and give them the talents of other races. If the Species Evolution before this was to 'become a stronger race', the Species Evolution of a Beyond Grade A was to 'absorb the essence of others to make their own race stronger'.

The absorption talent was not afraid of having a low Evolution Compatibility because it would not mutate.

Enduring the pain of the changes in his genes, Han Xiao hesitated for a while before choosing [Chaos Apostle] and [Void Missionary]. The former was to maintain the evolution system of [Void Pathfinder], and the latter was because of its existence as a 'Psychic Body'. Han Xiao felt that it should have the ability to increase his Psychic Resistance, which could make up for his weakness in the Psychic Body aspect to deal with Sisko.

You have received a new talent [Void Deity Echo].

You have received a new talent [Supreme Devotion].

[Void Deity Echo] came from [Chaos Apostle], and it could be used to connect to the Void Deity to obtain divine power. It was a near universal ability that could be used to apply negative statuses to the enemy, imprison them, control them, defend, or attack them. It could only be used for one purpose at a time, and it had a cooldown of five minutes. No matter what it was used for, the effect was very impressive. Simply put, it was similar to the Void Deity Character Summon Cards that could be used repeatedly.

[Supreme Devotion] was one of the talents of [Void Missionary]. It was a passive talent that increased his Psychic Resistance by ninety percent, making him immune to all kinds of Psychic Attacks, and there was a twenty percent chance to reflect Psychic Attacks.

"Great, I have a better chance of dealing with Sisko this way."

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised. This talent alone was comparable to all the Psychic Resistance talents he had.

This time, a new notification popped up on the interface.

Please select your Exclusive Race Talent.

This was the thirteenth talent brought by the Species Evolution, and it was also a unique talent of the Exclusive Race. It was no longer absorbing the talents of others but creating one on its own.

This unique talent was a Race Talent that could be passed down to future generations.

The interface listed out the possible talents, which were Attack, Defense, Resistance, Life, Machinery Affinity, and so on. The unique talent was related to the development direction of the Exclusive Race, and there was only one chance. Han Xiao did not mess around and chose the Machinery Talent. Choosing a talent related to his main class would definitely guarantee the effect.

Selection complete. Unique Talent is being generated. You have three chances to change your talent. Once confirmed, it cannot be canceled.

Generation complete.

[Innate Mechanical Sense]: + 180% Machinery Affinity, + 2 to all Machinery Type Skills. Actual effect can exceed level limit.

Confirm/Change.

Han Xiao shook his head. This talent was a little too ordinary, so he immediately used up one chance to change it.

Generating … Generating complete.

[Source of Mechanical Force]: When your Energy Attribute is Mechanical Force, you will receive an additional fifty Energy Points per level.

Confirm/Change.

This is not bad. If I confirm this talent, with my current level, I will have an additional twelve thousand Energy Points, and I should be able to receive a new level of Energy Attribute bonus.

It was almost impossible to create an ability at the level of a Molding Talent, so [Source of Mechanical Force] was already not bad.

There were only two chances left. Now that Fu Ding was not by his side, Han Xiao felt very insecure. He was worried that the African bloodline hidden in his genes would show its might again, so he hesitated.

Let's try again. A Beyond Grade A Unique Talent shouldn't be too bad, right?

Han Xiao made up his mind and used up another chance to change it.

Generating … Generating complete.

[Mechanical Genius]: Total Machinery Affinity x1.15, + 30% Machinery Creation Performance

Yo, this is not a loss!

Han Xiao was overjoyed.

A 1.15 times increase in Machinery Affinity, plus the 1.08 times increase in [Basic Mechanical Sense], was more than half of the 1.4 times increase in Reynold's Molding Talent [Perfect Mechanical Sense].

Furthermore, a 30% increase in Machinery Creation Performance was the most valuable ability, and the machinery created would have higher attributes. Just like how [Machinery Truth Grasp] increased the strength of the Mech Legion in all aspects, a 30% increase was enough to raise the level of the Mech Legion to another level.

It just so happened that he was going to rebuild the Mech Legion that was suitable for Beyond Grade As in the future. This ability was very useful.

"This is it!"

You have received the Unique Talent [Mechanical Genius]!

Tip: The effect of the Unique Talent will continue to increase as the race evolves.

Thirteen talents have been confirmed. Unique race has been born. Please name it …

Beyond Grade As were a brand new race. As the first existence of this race, Han Xiao could name his own race.

"What race should I call it? Void Machinery Race? Mechanical Tank Race? Business Genius Race? Pugilists who don't want to be Espers aren't good Mechanics? "

The pain of evolution was still ongoing, and Han Xiao frowned. He did not waste time thinking of a name and directly used his own.

He remembered that the Zergs he had rescued in the past called themselves the Black Spirit Race and did not steal his name.

Unique Race Name has been confirmed.

Your Race has been changed: Black Star Race.

Race Appearance Identification … Based on your evolution experience, the highest change in your appearance is 2.7%. Do you wish to maintain your original appearance?

Does this mean that I can change my face? Han Xiao looked at it. Because he had been maintaining his human form, the upper limit of the change was very small. He did not want to change and chose to maintain his original appearance.

Life Level Sublimation, Molecular Structure Improvement, Organ Structure Enhancement, Metabolism Change …

[Race Transformation] has been completed. Your Grade has been raised to S (Beyond Grade A).

+ 100 END! 1 END = 310 Health = 320 Stamina.

Grade A Bonuses have disappeared.

You have received a Rank S Bonus.

Han Xiao clenched his fists in excitement. Just like when he had obtained [Superhuman] after breaking through to the Calamity Grade, Grade S also had a specific talent. This was also the main factor in widening the gap between a Calamity Grade and a Beyond Grade A.

1. Physical Resistance

2. Mental Resistance

3. Power Bonus.

4. Status Enhancement Type

5. Health Points

6. Explosive Strength

7. Energy Points

Han Xiao focused on thinking. Power Bonus was a must. Just like [Superhuman], it increased the strength of all his abilities. This was the source of the destructive power of a Beyond Grade A, including the Mechanical Force bonus.

He was conflicted about the second option, hesitating between Mental Resistance and Health.

Mental Resistance could be used to deal with Sisko, but Health had the same effect and even more uses. He had not forgotten about EsGod and the Tyrant, these two strong enemies who did not use mental attacks.

You have received the Grade Talent [Supreme Power]!

You have received Grade Talent [Eternal Body]!

[Supreme Power]: You have comprehended a power that surpasses the Calamity Grade. The energy wandering in the universe is under your control. The strength of your abilities has been increased (including but not limited to various weapons and equipment, mechanical creations enhanced by Mechanical Force, summoned creatures, and other combat methods controlled by yourself). The bonus effect depends on the total level of the character. Level 1 – Level 100: + 4% Attack every 10 levels; Level 100 – Level 200: + 6% Attack every 10 levels; Level 200 and above: + 10% Attack every 10 levels.

Current Ability Power Amplification: 140% (This amplification can be stacked with [Superpower])

Current Effect: + 120 END Bonus.

"The buffs from these two talents … are too terrifying!"

Han Xiaoxin was shocked.

No wonder a Beyond Grade A is so strong!

The tearing pain became more and more intense. Han Xiao focused on feeling the drastic changes in his body.

Just as Austin had said, after advancing to the Beyond Grade A realm, his mind had become extremely tough. The soul embryo in his brain had died on its own. This thing was like a tumor that absorbed nutrients and was directly destroyed by the Beyond Grade A's mental strength.

The series of negative statuses of the psychic poison on the interface were all removed at this moment, and his body returned to its peak state.

…

After about a few hours, the pain finally subsided, and what replaced it was a feeling of power that was constantly expanding. The feeling this time was even more intense than before. His perception of the world had never been so clear and detailed.

The energy in his body was boiling, and it seeped out from every pore. His entire body was emitting a faint blue light.

"I've finally succeeded!"

Han Xiaoxin was excited. He had walked all the way from the Blue Star. From today onward, he would also be a Beyond Grade A who stood at the top of the galaxy!

Calming his mind, Han Xiao divided the Free Attribute Points equally between his Intelligence and Endurance before browsing his interface.

Even though he was mentally prepared, he could not help but be shocked by the interface after advancing to the Beyond Grade A realm.

His attributes were several times higher than a Calamity Grade!

Total Level: 240

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Black Star Race

Attributes: 2,346 STR, 2,930 DEX, 4,265 END, 6,672 INT, 2,108 MYS, 986 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 84

Health: 2533510

Stamina: 2487270

Energy: 52270 [Lv.15]

Lv.15 Energy Bonuses: + 671 STR, + 848 DEX, + 1080 END, + 1,305 INT, + 653 MYS, + 141520 Stamina Limit, + 952% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 43837

Grade: S (Beyond Grade A)

The power of a Beyond Grade A far surpasses that of a Calamity Grade. No matter which Star Field you are in, you will stand at the top.

"Too strong …" Han Xiao's eyes widened in excitement.

The increase in strength of a Beyond Grade A was extremely terrifying. It was a completely new realm compared to a Calamity Grade.

With these attributes, it was no wonder that no Calamity Grade was a match for a Beyond Grade A. Even before he advanced, he could not defeat a Beyond Grade A. These two levels were like the difference between species. No matter what, a human would not be able to kill a Godzilla with his bare hands.

He had more than 2,500,000 HP, and who knew how much HP the Tyrant had. Just the thought of it was terrifying.

If not for the Primordial Ones breaking through this limit, perhaps the universe would still think that the Calamity Grade was the limit of an individual's strength.

"This is the power of a Beyond Grade A …"

Han Xiao felt the changes in his body and felt as though he could penetrate the planet beneath his feet.

This time, it was most likely not an illusion!

Beep beep!

Before he could test the limits of his strength, Philip suddenly sent him a message.

"Master, hum … the radar has detected a spaceship outside the atmosphere. Hum!"

Han Xiao suddenly raised his head. His vision seemed to be able to penetrate the thick rock walls and lock onto a water droplet-shaped spaceship outside the planet.

"Sisko? I spent a few hours promoting, and he finally caught up to me … "

Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

This was the best opponent. He could fight with Sisko and test how strong he was among the Beyond Grade As!

…

(Wow, these numbers are killing me. I woke up at 2: 30 am to type until now, and I haven't even eaten lunch and dinner. I'm begging for votes. My word count for the past three days has been okay, more than 5000 words. Today, it's almost 6000 words.)
